title: console: localize the organization-limit refusal (YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS) in the create-workspace dialog
body:
Filing gate ②: a gap measured while landing objectstack-ai/cloud#3382, Sam's 「D 也做」 (2026-10-30 12:51Z), which lowers the hosted org cap to 2. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

cloud 把每人可建组织数降到了 2。用户建第 3 个组织时，服务端会拒绝（403 `YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS`）。但控制台的「新建工作空间」对话框没有为这个错误码准备文案，只显示 better-auth 的英文原句，中文用户看到的是英文，也不知道上限是多少。这张卡给这个错误码加上各语言文案。

## Facts (objectstack main)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts`: `ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS` has no row for `YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS`, so the dialog falls back to better-auth's English "You have reached the maximum number of organizations".
- Measured by cloud#3382's test `org-limit-flow.test.ts` (PR cloud#3384): a third owned org is refused with 403 and that code.

## Work

1. Map the code to a localized key in every i18n pack, e.g. 「你自己创建的组织已达上限。被邀请加入的组织不计入。」
2. If the refusal body or the public config exposes the limit, name the number. Otherwise do not invent one.
3. Tests: the code renders the localized string in zh and en. Include an ablation.

## Done when

A zh session that hits the org cap sees a Chinese message that explains it.
